items.proposed: CDK4_6_pathway (RB1 wild-type), eligibility, candidate_matched true, abemaciclib
items.reason: "Validation of wild-type RB status" is an entry requirement; intact RB1 is the downstream target of CDK4/6 inhibition, so the CDK4_6_pathway category (coder A) fits better than 'other'. Same row as coder B's; the primary outcome is true either way (CDKN2A_B row also matched).

items.proposed: keep row: other (1p/19q co-deletion, stated as exclusion), eligibility, candidate_matched false; exempt from any_molecular_selection
items.reason: "Prior evidence of 1p/19q co-deletion" is an exclusion criterion; D31-A4 counts exclusion-stated biomarkers as eligibility, but D31-A5 exempts exclusions that only define CNS5 glioblastoma (1p/19q-codeleted tumours excluded) from any_molecular_selection, like IDH-wildtype. No effect on outcomes.

items.proposed: CDK4_6_pathway (RB1 wild-type), eligibility, candidate_matched true, abemaciclib
items.reason: Coder B's 'other' RB1 row is the same requirement as coder A's; propose category CDK4_6_pathway. candidate_matched_selection stays true.

note: IDH1/2 mutation and 1p/19q co-deletion are exclusions that define GBM only (D31-A5) and do not count towards any_molecular_selection. Selection already positive via CDKN2A/B/C homozygous deletion and RB1 wild-type entry requirements.

revisions.to: keep row as eligibility, not candidate-matched, exempt from any_molecular_selection
revisions.reason: The record excludes "Prior evidence of 1p/19q co-deletion", an exclusion that only defines CNS5 glioblastoma, so D31-A4/A5 keep it as an exempt eligibility row rather than dropping it.
